title: Tariff Note: Agency Service Fee and Currency Conversion Markup across the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
The agency service fee and the currency conversion markup are the two amounts the agency itself sets on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation rather than the property. Both are carried by the rate plan booked.

| Rate plan | Agency booking service fee, USD | Currency conversion markup, percent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 19.95 | 3.5 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 17.95 | 3.5 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 14.95 | 3.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 12.95 | 3.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | 0.0 | 2.5 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 9.95 | 2.5 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.0 | 2.0 |

**The agency booking service fee** is the fee charged once per reservation, in USD. **The currency conversion markup** is the percentage added when the guest elects to be charged in a currency other than the property's own.

## Points of judgement on the two figures

*On which plans carry no service fee.* The Member Flex Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate record 0.0, and a reservation on either of them carries no agency booking service fee at all. Every other plan records a positive figure.

*On the spread of the markup.* The markup falls as the plan becomes more inclusive: 3.5 percent on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, 3.0 percent on the Semi-Flexible Rate and the Standard Flexible Rate, 2.5 percent on the Member Flex Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate, and 2.0 percent on the All-Inclusive Flex Rate. No plan records a markup of nothing.

*On a worked reading.* Taking a hypothetical room total of 400.00 USD presented in a currency other than the property's own on the Semi-Flexible Rate, the markup this schedule records for that plan is 3.0 percent, and 3.0 percent of 400.00 USD is 12.00 USD.
